posts.title: AI Is Changing Social Media, but Can We Still Trust What We See?
posts.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) has made it easier than ever to create and share content online. From realistic images and videos to posts that appear to come from legitimate news organizations, AI is changing the way people consume information on social media.
